aggregation: Arithmetic mean over the same 112 complete cases; one fresh process per case.
primary_timer: Fresh common model compilation through complete fixed-frequency selection/validation; Sequential uses same origin and includes all refinements plus selection/validation. All three restricted builders and greedy/beam initializers included.
excluded_from_primary_timer: Interpreter/import startup and license environment initialization
Reading catalog, workload and reference JSONs and hashing provenance; the internal admission-grid CSV read remains inside model preparation
Archival comparison audit and result/log file I/O
GPU inference, profiling and offline Monte Carlo
cache_policy: Fresh process per case; clear admission caches before timer; natural reuse within case is preserved.
comparability: The other Figure 5 timings are historical sums of components. Fixed-frequency and Sequential were remeasured in a separate acquisition on the same host.
objective_data_policy: Figure 5 uses archived objective data and physical results.
